title: .ai/config.yaml
description: Project-owned configuration read by an AI assistant to determine which skills/rules from the toolkit apply to this specific project. Lives at .ai/config.yaml in the consuming project, outside the toolkit submodule.

domains.description: Which knowledge tracks apply. Most non-AI services list only ["dotnet"].

architecture.description: e.g. 'clean-architecture', 'modular-monolith', 'vertical-slice', 'microservices'. The AI must confirm this against the actual codebase before relying on it (AGENTS.md workflows/project-discovery.md) rather than assuming it stayed accurate.

model_providers.description: e.g. ['anthropic', 'azure-openai'] — drives which skills/agentic-ai/frameworks/* entries are relevant.

frameworks.description: e.g. ['semantic-kernel'] — gates 'optional' skill resolution. Empty means framework-neutral / hand-rolled.

rag.description: Recorded RAG decisions; only meaningful when 'rag' is in ai.patterns. Unset means undecided: the AI follows agentic-ai.rag-patterns 'When the User Is Unsure' and writes the outcome back here.

chunking.description: Chunking strategies in use, named as in the agentic-ai.chunking catalog, e.g. ['structure-aware', 'parent-child'].

patterns.description: RAG patterns adopted beyond the naive baseline (which is implied), named as in agentic-ai.rag-patterns, e.g. ['hybrid-search', 'reranking']. List a pattern only after an evaluation showed it earns its cost.

evaluation_set.description: Repo-relative path to the RAG evaluation question set (answerable, unanswerable, unauthorized cases).
